boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented McMinnville-campus settings for quiet work, group projects, computer access, writing support or a short reset between study sessions.

cards.title: Settle In at Nicholson Library
cards.subtitle: A spacious setting documented for quiet study
cards.notes: Bring your Linfield ID, choose a quiet work area and check the live library schedule before planning an evening session.
cards.short_summary: The university specifically presents Nicholson Library as a comfortable, spacious place for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield describes Nicholson Library as comfortable and spacious, identifies it as a place for quiet study and publishes separate academic-term access hours for students and the public.
cards.access_notes: Academic-term access for students, faculty and staff is Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–midnight, Friday 7:30 a.m.–6 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday noon–midnight; hours may change.

cards.title: Take a Project Into a Study Room
cards.subtitle: Private library rooms for solo or group work
cards.notes: Check out a room when conversation or collaboration would disrupt an open study area, and confirm the current loan procedure at the desk.
cards.short_summary: Private rooms provide a defined setting for studying and group projects inside Nicholson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield defines its library study rooms as private rooms that can be checked out for studying or working on group projects.
cards.access_notes: A checkout is required; the official page does not state room capacity, loan duration or advance-reservation rules.

cards.title: Read in the Austin Reading Room
cards.subtitle: A named reading room inside Nicholson Library
cards.notes: Use the room for focused reading when it is not hosting a lecture, showcase or discussion; check library events before settling in.
cards.short_summary: This identifiable Nicholson Library room supports reading while also serving scheduled academic gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Current Linfield pages locate the Austin Reading Room within Nicholson Library and document it as the site of collaborative research discussions and academic presentations.
cards.access_notes: The room hosts scheduled programs, so availability for informal study is not guaranteed; consult the library calendar and posted notices.

cards.title: Bring a Draft to the Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Library support for papers in progress
cards.notes: Arrive with a draft or specific writing question and use the center for help editing, drafting or clarifying your next revision.
cards.short_summary: A task-focused stop for moving an essay from rough notes toward a stronger draft.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies the Writing Center as a Nicholson Library location where students can receive help editing, writing or drafting papers.
cards.access_notes: The cited page confirms the location and service but does not publish current drop-in hours or appointment requirements.

cards.title: Review Media in a Screening Room
cards.subtitle: Library spaces intended for watching films
cards.notes: Ask library staff about availability before bringing a course film, and use headphones or the room’s approved playback setup as directed.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-specific option for assignments that require attentive film or video viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies screening rooms in Nicholson Library as areas where users can watch movies.
cards.access_notes: The official glossary confirms the rooms and their purpose but does not state reservation, equipment or eligibility rules; ask library staff first.

cards.title: Work From the Renshaw Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: A map-listed computer lab in Renshaw Hall
cards.notes: Choose this lab when an assignment needs campus computing, and verify door access and software availability before a deadline.
cards.short_summary: The current campus map identifies a dedicated computer lab within an academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s current McMinnville campus map lists a Computer Lab among the facilities in Renshaw Hall.
cards.access_notes: The campus map confirms the lab but does not state current hours, card-access requirements or available software.

cards.title: Spread Out in Fred Meyer Lounge
cards.subtitle: A Riley Campus Center gathering space beside Starbucks
cards.notes: Use a table for informal work between commitments, but check posted programming because activities and gatherings can occupy the lounge.
cards.short_summary: A central, social alternative to library study with nearby campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies Fred Meyer Lounge in Riley Campus Center next to Starbucks and states that many activities and gatherings take place there.
cards.access_notes: This is a multipurpose gathering space, not a designated quiet room; availability and noise depend on scheduled campus activities.

cards.entity_name: Riley Campus Center Prayer and Meditation Room
cards.title: Pause in the Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: A second-floor space open to every faith tradition
cards.notes: Step away for a quiet reset before returning to coursework, and preserve the room’s reflective purpose for everyone who enters.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus room for quiet reflection rather than group work or conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that the prayer and meditation room is on the second floor of Riley Campus Center and is available to all students and all faith traditions.
cards.access_notes: Available to all students; the cited page does not publish room hours, occupancy limits or a reservation process.

cards.title: Connect at the Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: A student gathering space in Withnell Commons
cards.notes: Use the center for community-oriented work or a study check-in, while respecting events and the space’s belonging-focused mission.
cards.short_summary: A named gathering environment suited to collaborative, community-connected campus work.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies the Multicultural Center as a space where students gather for events and celebrations and locates it in Withnell Commons by the mailroom.
cards.access_notes: The official page confirms its location and gathering function but does not publish general study access, operating hours or event closures.

cards.title: Use Potter Hall’s Study Room
cards.subtitle: A residence-hall room that does not require reservation
cards.notes: If you have authorized residence-hall access, bring quiet coursework here when library rooms are unavailable and follow housing rules.
cards.short_summary: A documented no-reservation study room for students who can legitimately access Potter Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that residence halls such as Potter contain study rooms that do not have to be reserved.
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required, but Potter Hall is student housing; use only with authorized building access and follow residence-life policies.
